verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own Crash Reporting export, covering all or selected error groups or all data within a time range. The changelog separately mentions CSV exports that follow applied filters, which shows an open format for at least some views. The evidence does not show a full-account export across every product (crash, RUM, APM), and the format of the crash export itself is not stated. missing for 10: confirmation that every product's data (RUM, APM, deployments, settings) is exportable, explicit open formats (CSV/JSON) for the crash-reporting export, bulk or API-based full-account export for leaving the service, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.
You can also select to export all data within a specific time range.
Aligned **CSV exports** with applied top-level filters.
